adjudication.depicted_input: Model architecture and training panel showing H&E imaging and spatial sequencing as inputs, Image FM/ST FM feature extraction, contrastive alignment, and ST prediction; lower insets explicitly show TCGA/GTEx/in-house image FM pretraining and HEST1K ST FM fine-tuning.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is a broad cohort summary and is weaker as an input depiction. Figure 2 is visibly better because it directly shows the route-level input interface: H&E images entering the Image FM, paired H&E and spatial sequencing for contrastive training, and the shared H&E-to-ST prediction mechanism used across the paper. This supports the image pretraining route, the paired H&E-ST alignment route, and evaluation routes that reuse the same depicted H&E-to-ST input mechanism.
